newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold trade subdued, prices firm slightly.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold trade subdued, prices firm slightly.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange remained subdued on Monday, with volume down to 635 kilos from Friday's 702 kilos as traders were sidelined, awaiting direction from world markets, dealers said.
Gold closed slightly firmer at $341.30 an ounce and 1,506,000 lira per gram, compared to $341 and 1,490,700 lira on Friday, following trends in European markets.
The Turkish lira fell to 136,300 lira to the dollar on Monday, versus 135,420 lira at Friday's close, helping the lira term gold prices to firm.
Most of the day's trade -- 400 kilos -- took place in the morning session, with 80.3 percent of the total traded in lira terms.
